title: Hybrid Approach to Fabricate Uniform and Active Molecular Junctions

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: Sub-5 nm metal-molecule-metal junctions need uniform, well-defined gaps that evaporated contacts cannot give. A room-temperature hybrid route can build uniform active junctions whose top contact stays mechanically free to move.
states.detail: Absorbed: n1 (HYP/need), n2 (HYP/hypothesis), n3 (DES/architecture), n4 (DES/route), n5 (PRC/forming), n7 (PRC/deposition), n9 (PRC/forming), n11 (DES/variable_sweep), n12 (PRC/stimulus), n16 (DES/down_select), n17 (PRC/stimulus). Premises: PEG monolayers are known to be compressible whereas dodecanethiol packs into a film of higher Young's modulus

states.title: Structure state
states.head: The peeled Au electrode surface is ultrasmooth over the whole electrode array. A PEG-thiol monolayer bearing C-H and C-O groups is assembled on the peeled gold surface.

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: The applied voltage pulls the contacts together, compressing the monolayer and narrowing the tunnelling gap exponentially raising current. The PEG-thiol gap compresses to about 0.63 of its initial width by 2.4 V while the dodecanethiol gap stays unchanged.

states.title: Performance state
states.head: The hexanedithiol device works stably: no hysteresis and a run-to-run spread narrower than the curve up to 2 V

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: Template stripping, self-assembly and nanorod trapping together give uniform, electrically active and electromechanically tunable molecular junctions

nodes.title: MICRO, F4
nodes.head: Peeled in air the electrode ends carry large torn gold mounds and dark voids; peeled in water the electrodes stay intact
nodes.note: the water-peeled panel shows fine dark pitting of the surrounding adhesive that the air-peeled panel does not
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for n5 (o5).

nodes.title: SEM, TEM, F3, F5
nodes.head: TEM cross-sections show a continuous bright molecular layer of even thickness between a flat nanorod facet and the smooth Au film
nodes.solves: A uniform metal-molecule-metal junction forms between a flat nanorod facet and the ultrasmooth film, its gap set by the monolayer
nodes.note: F5d shows the whole pentagonal rod cross-section on an unbroken layer; the top-view SEM F5c (opened, not cited) shows one rod overlapping both electrodes
nodes.necessity_reason: n10 keeps shown support from o2, o7 after removal.

nodes.title: MICRO, F3
nodes.head: In the evaporated-contact junction the gap line is faint, broken and locally pinched between grainy contacts
nodes.note: same 20 nm bar as F3b; the whole field is low contrast, so the gap is only intermittently resolved
nodes.necessity_reason: n10 keeps shown support from o1, o7 after removal.

nodes.title: MICRO, F4

nodes.title: evidence, F6, F7
nodes.head: PEG-thiol run 1: current climbs about six decades to the 1 uA compliance by 2.5 V and the return branch runs up to three decades above the forward branch. The variable-gap Simmons curve tracks the PEG run-1 forward sweep over four decades while the constant-gap curve falls up to two decades below it above 1.5 V.
nodes.solves: The applied voltage pulls the contacts together, compressing the monolayer and narrowing the tunnelling gap exponentially raising current
nodes.op: convert to quantity, overlay model on data, read trend
nodes.note: the same pair of dotted curves in F6b are only about half a decade apart at 3 V, so the discrimination is much weaker there the caption sets the variable-gap fit against the fixed-gap case without saying the two are indistinguishable here
nodes.detail: o8: PEG-thiol run 1: current climbs about six decades to the 1 uA compliance by 2.5 V and the return branch runs up to three decades above the forward branch; o13: The variable-gap Simmons curve tracks the PEG run-1 forward sweep over four decades while the constant-gap curve falls up to two decades below it above 1.5 V; a1: In F7 the variable-gap and constant-gap Simmons curves both lie inside the sigma band, so this device does not separate the two models

nodes.title: evidence, F6
nodes.head: Successive runs push both junctions to higher current: PEG-thiol hits compliance below ~1 V by run 12, dodecanethiol fans up to ~1 uA by run 100
nodes.solves: Repeated sweeping raises the gap conductance irreversibly in both the PEG-thiol and the dodecanethiol junction
nodes.note: the caption plots only select PEG runs; the dodecanethiol drift over 100 runs is as large as the PEG drift over 12
